info.longName: Xtrackers Emerging Markets Carbon Reduction and Climate Improvers ETF

funds_data.description: The index is comprised of large and mid-capitalization companies in emerging markets countries that meet certain ESG criteria and/or have committed to greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets. The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of issuers from countries classified as emerging markets. It is non-diversified.
